title: Project Controller
description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.


Primary Purpose of Job:


Intermediate level position, assigned for Portfolio Analysis, Major Projects Support etc. Under appropriate supervision, perform routine project control assignments according to training, capability and experience. In addition, perform duties as \& when assigned. This position primarily focused on supporting the project managers, project leads and other team members in the areas of scheduling, costing and concepts related to the industry technology, project management and earned value management.


Key Accountabilities:


* Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated CPM schedules for major programs and a portfolio of projects.
* Review schedule, progress and productivity of resources; monitor and verify monthly costs and earned value; and conduct change order management and control.
* Develop, manage and monitor program and project specific budgets, cash flow projections and forecasts.
* Evaluate and update data regarding cost status, resource requirements and productivity variance reports.
* Develop and prepare monthly project progress reports.
* Develop concise progress summary reports.
* Develop and prepare any specific reporting requirement of Project Managers
* Interface directly with Project Managers in order to review project plans, budgets, status reports and deliverables. Ensure that work products meet standards as defined by Stantec.
* Willingness to learn and adapt new tools and system/processes.
* Project design management and co\-ordination with project teams.
* Willingness to work late evening or early morning hours to enable collaboration with project managers located throughout the globe.

Person Specifications:


* B. Tech/B.E (Civil/Construction/Mechanical)
* Post\-Graduation in Construction Management would be preferable.
* 4\+ years of professional experience.
* Experience in project controls, scheduling, cost engineering and cost control pertaining to engineering and construction activities will be an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills required. This is a very essential requirement to maintain seamless collaboration with project managers.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau will be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated experience of earlier project design management and co\-ordination with project team will be an added advantage.
* Demonstrated competence in MS Office applications.

**Primary Location:** India \| Pune


**Organization:** Stantec IN Business Unit


**Employee Status:** Regular


**Business Justification:** New Position


**Travel:** No


**Schedule:** Full time


**Job Posting:** 17/09/2026 11:09:26


**Req ID:** 1007573

title: Delivery Manager - Project Management
description:

### **Job Title**


**Delivery Manager – Digital Engineering**


### **Experience**


**20\+ Years**


### **Location**



Pune


### **Role Overview**



We are seeking an experienced **Delivery Manager \- Digital Engineering** with 20\+ years of experience in leading large\-scale digital transformation programs, managing global delivery teams, and driving successful execution of enterprise technology initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, extensive experience in Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data \& Analytics, AI/ML, Application Modernization, Agile delivery, and stakeholder management.



The role requires ownership of end\-to\-end delivery, customer relationship management, revenue growth, operational excellence, resource planning, and ensuring successful delivery outcomes across multiple programs and portfolios.



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Delivery Leadership**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Digital Engineering engagements across multiple customers and business units.
* Manage large\-scale digital transformation programs involving Cloud, Data Engineering, AI, Analytics, Application Modernization, Platform Engineering, and DevOps.
* Drive delivery excellence through effective planning, execution, governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations.

### **Client \& Stakeholder Management**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with CXOs, Business Leaders, and key customer stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor for customers on digital transformation initiatives.
* Conduct executive steering committee meetings and provide regular program health updates.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.

### **Program \& Portfolio Management**


* Manage multiple programs and portfolios with complete accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Establish governance frameworks, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms.
* Monitor project financials including revenue, margins, utilization, and profitability.
* Drive operational efficiencies across delivery teams.

### **People Leadership**


* Lead and mentor large cross\-functional teams comprising Architects, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Scrum Masters, and Engineers.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, performance management, and employee engagement.
* Build high\-performing delivery organizations aligned to business objectives.
* Support strategic hiring, workforce planning, and capability development.

### **Business Growth \& Presales Support**


* Partner with Sales and Account teams to identify growth opportunities.
* Support solutioning, estimations, RFP/RFI responses, and customer presentations.
* Drive account mining and expansion opportunities within existing customers.
* Contribute to revenue growth and strategic business initiatives.

### **Delivery Governance \& Quality**


* Establish delivery best practices, Agile methodologies, DevOps culture, and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and delivery maturity programs.
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and organizational policies.
* Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
-----------------------------------


### **Technical \& Domain Expertise**


* Strong understanding of Digital Engineering landscape.
* Experience in Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP.
* Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, and Modern Data Platforms.
* Application Development and Modernization.
* DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Automation practices.
* Enterprise Architecture and Digital Transformation programs.

### **Leadership Skills**


* Strategic thinking and decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder and customer management.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen.
* Conflict resolution and negotiation skills.
* Program governance and risk management.

### **Delivery Management Expertise**


* Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall delivery models.
* Portfolio and Program Management.
* Resource Management and Capacity Planning.
* Budgeting, Financial Tracking, and Margin Management.
* Vendor and Partner Management.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Master's degree (MBA/PGDM) preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as:
	+ PMP
	+ PMI\-ACP
	+ SAFe Program Consultant (SPC)
	+ Azure/AWS Cloud Certifications
	+ ITIL
	+ Scrum Certifications

**Desired Experience**
----------------------


* 20\+ years of overall IT industry experience.
* 10\+ years in leading large Digital Engineering programs.
* Experience managing global distributed delivery teams of 100\+ resources.
* Proven track record in delivering multi\-million\-dollar transformation programs.
* Experience working with enterprise customers across Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, BFSI, Telecom, or Technology sectors.
* Strong experience in managing P\&L, revenue, margins, utilization, and customer satisfaction metrics.

**Key Success Metrics**
-----------------------


* On\-time and quality delivery of programs.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and NPS scores.
* Revenue growth and margin achievement.
* Resource utilization and talent retention.
* Delivery excellence and operational efficiency.
* Successful execution of strategic digital transformation initiatives.


**Preferred Candidate Profile:** A seasoned Digital Engineering leader capable of driving large\-scale transformation programs, managing multi\-million\-dollar portfolios, leading global teams, and partnering with executive stakeholders to deliver business outcomes and growth.

title: AI Program Management Office (PMO) & Resource Management
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title:** **AI Program Management Office (PMO) \& Resource Management**

**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

* Indra is the central program driving the introduction and safe scaling of AI at Deutsche Bank. The program focuses on identifying AI opportunities across banking operations, accelerating funded use cases into production, creating enterprise AI capabilities, enabling safe and scalable AI adoption, and establishing the governance framework required to support responsible AI deployment across the bank.
* As an AVP within the Indra Chief Strategy Office team, you will play a key role in supporting program governance, workforce management, resource planning, financial tracking, stakeholder reporting, and execution oversight across a complex portfolio of AI initiatives. You will work closely with global program leadership, product teams, technology partners, finance, HR, and senior stakeholders to ensure effective resource allocation, transparent reporting, and successful program delivery.
* You will join a global team responsible for driving AI transformation across Deutsche Bank and contribute to scaling AI adoption through strong program management disciplines and operational excellence.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,


* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* Support program governance activities, including steering committee materials, management updates, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, and action tracking.
* Develop and maintain executive reporting dashboards and management information packs, providing transparency on program delivery, resource utilization, and operational metrics.
* Drive consistency in project management standards, reporting frameworks, governance documentation, and execution controls across the program.
* Support strategic workforce planning and resource capacity assessments to ensure alignment between program demand and available capabilities.
* Partner with global teams to track key program deliverables, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements across multiple workstreams.
* Facilitate stakeholder communications and ensure timely escalation and resolution of program\-related issues.
* Maintain program\-wide workforce and resource management processes across AI initiatives, ensuring accurate tracking of headcount, capacity, demand, and supply.
* Manage resource planning activities, including forecasting, onboarding, offboarding, hiring demand, contractor management, and workforce reporting.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, Procurement, and business stakeholders to support budget planning, cost tracking, workforce approvals, and resource governance processes.

**Your skills and experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Technology, or a related field.
* 8\-10 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, Resource Management, Workforce Planning, or Business Management roles within large\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong experience in resource planning, capacity management, workforce reporting, and governance within a global organization.
* Experience creating executive\-level presentations, dashboards, management reports, and governance materials for senior leadership.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience within banking, financial services, technology, or large transformation programs is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI, data, analytics, or technology programs would be advantageous.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.


Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.


We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
